name: GlideDigest
title: GlideDigest - Scoped
summary: The scoped GlideDigest class provides methods for creating a message digest from strings or input streams using MD5, SHA1, or SHA256 hash algorithms.

members.name: GlideDigest
members.summary: Creates an instance of scoped GlideDigest.

members.name: getMD5Base64
members.summary: Creates a message digest from a string using the MD5 algorithm. The output string is in Base64.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
source String The source string.
Returns
Type Description
String The message digest. 
var inputString = "Her molasses flowed slowly down the hill.";
var digest = new GlideDigest();
gs.info(digest.getMD5Base64(inputString));

members.name: getMD5Base64FromInputStream
members.summary: Creates a message digest from an input stream using the MD5 algorithm. The output string is in Base64.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
inputStream GlideScriptableInputStream The source input stream.
Returns
Type Description
String The message digest. 
var inputStream = new GlideSysAttachment().getContentStream(attachmentSysID);
var digest = new GlideDigest();
gs.info(digest.getMD5Base64FromInputStream(inputStream));
